name: Fetch MokN Login Attempts
description: Collect MokN bait attempts and forward them to Sekoia.io

intake_server.title: Intake Server
intake_server.description: Override the default intake server used by Sekoia.io

intake_key.title: Intake Key
intake_key.description: Intake key to use when sending events

chunk_size.title: Chunk Size
chunk_size.description: Maximum number of events forwarded to the intake in a single batch

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of login summaries requested per page

initial_lookback_minutes.title: Initial Lookback Minutes
initial_lookback_minutes.description: How far to look back when no checkpoint exists yet

query_window_minutes.title: Query Window Minutes
query_window_minutes.description: Size of each API polling window in minutes

threat_levels.title: Threat Levels
threat_levels.description: Threat levels filter applied to MokN login attempts

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Whether to restrict the query to pending attempts

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: List of MokN status codes included in the polling query. Accepts integer values. Refer to the API documentation available in the console for the supported codes.
